assetPrompts.ledge-root: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original isolated 3D reference concept for a production videogame terrain model. On a plain warm off-white background, show ONE coherent massive ancient sandstone cliff landing. The asset's broad irregular rounded-square grassy top is approximately ten metres across, eight metres deep, and the deep stone root drops eight metres beneath it. Front three-quarter view from a moderately elevated camera, clearly show complete broad top, front and right sides, and tapered lower root; object fills frame with breathing room, no crop. Sculpt the footprint as an asymmetrical lobed rock shelf with concave breaks and softened fractured corners; not a rectangular box. A fairly flat quiet walking area of SHORT desaturated olive-green turf covers the top, with small random tufts and muted soil patches. Expose a thin warm tan stone-cap rim around the top edge, broad enough to read at game camera distance. Below the cap, exactly THREE very broad thick sandstone rock courses with rounded chunky faces, uneven overhangs and two deeply recessed dark cool-brown horizontal fractures. The lower course narrows into a coherent tapered cliff finger/root rather than a pedestal box. Some large vertical corner fractures offset the broad masses. Keep smooth organic rock volume and broad surface planes, varied matte warm golden ochre and rusty tan painterly sediment gradients, quiet sparse muted olive moss inside crevices, minimal dangling moss. Rich premium stylized realistic game sculpt, crisp substantial geometry with restrained fine painted detail, true ambient creases and soft nondirectional studio light. No decorative plants, vines, trees, carvings, ruins, water, scene terrain, platform stand, text, logos, watermark, extra objects, emerald carpet, repeated tiny pancake strata, stone brick wall, sharp box corners, gritty photographic texture or glossy material. ORIGINAL design only.
assetPrompts.canyon-buttress: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original isolated 3D reference concept for a production videogame canyon terrain model. On a plain warm off-white background, show ONE enormous coherent ancient sandstone canyon buttress, approximately fourteen metres across, eighteen metres high, nine metres deep. It has exactly THREE huge thick rounded broad rock courses, each around five to six metres tall, separated by TWO deeply recessed dark cool-brown fractured seams. Front three-quarter view with slightly elevated camera so the full irregular upper crown, front, right side and foot are visible, object fills the frame with breathing room and no crop. The mass is substantial and organic, asymmetrical and gently tapered, with huge smoothly rounded weathered faces, broad planes, softened fractured corners, deep concave intersections and a few major vertical splits. Each thick stratum projects/recedes differently: one enormous broad upper brow, a broad concave waist and a wide heavy buttressed root. Top silhouette is uneven and sloping, never a flat rectangular roof. Quiet hand-painted matte warm ochre sandstone, golden tan broad highlights, rusty sediment gradients and cool brown shaded recesses, very sparse desaturated olive moss ONLY inside deep crevices and narrow sheltered crown pockets. Premium stylized realistic videogame rock sculpt, strong broad geometry, restrained fine painted surface detail, soft nondirectional studio light with true ambient creases. No tiny pancake stacks, repeated stair-step layers, blocky brick wall, planks, platforms, huge green moss lids, leaves, vines, plants, trees, ornament, carvings, temple, ground plane, backdrop scenery, text, logo, watermark, glossy material or gritty photographic texture.
